subjects.name: Matrices and Calculus
subjects.syllabus: Covers matrix algebra, eigenvalues, multivariable calculus, and applications to engineering problem solving.

subjects.name: Engineering Physics
subjects.syllabus: Introduces modern physics, semiconductors, wave optics, and practical applications in electronics.

subjects.name: C Programming and Data Structures
subjects.syllabus: Builds foundational programming, arrays, functions, recursion, and data structure concepts for engineering work.

subjects.name: Computer Aided Engineering Graphics
subjects.syllabus: Covers projections, geometric construction, drafting, and CAD skills for engineering communication.

subjects.name: Basic Electrical and Electronics Engineering
subjects.syllabus: Provides fundamentals of electrical circuits, machines, semiconductors, and basic electronics application.

subjects.name: Engineering Physics Laboratory
subjects.syllabus: Practical experiments on optics, semiconductor properties, and measurement techniques.

subjects.name: C Programming and Data Structures Laboratory
subjects.syllabus: Hands-on coding exercises on arrays, strings, functions, recursion, queues, stacks, and linked lists.

subjects.name: Basic Electrical and Electronics Engineering Laboratory
subjects.syllabus: Lab verification of circuits, machines, electronics, and measurement procedures.

subjects.name: Ordinary Differential Equations and Vector Calculus
subjects.syllabus: Covers ODEs, Laplace transforms, vector calculus, and their use in engineering models.

subjects.name: Engineering Chemistry
subjects.syllabus: Introduces water chemistry, electrochemistry, corrosion, polymers, and materials relevant to engineering practice.

subjects.name: English for Skill Enhancement
subjects.syllabus: Builds communication, grammar, reading, and professional writing skills for engineering careers.

subjects.name: Python Programming
subjects.syllabus: Introduces Python syntax, control flow, data handling, functions, and engineering problem solving.

subjects.name: Python Programming Laboratory
subjects.syllabus: Hands-on Python problem solving with loops, lists, functions, handling of data and output.

subjects.name: Electronic Devices and Circuits
subjects.syllabus: Introduces semiconductor devices, diode and transistor behavior, biasing, and basic amplifier design.

subjects.name: Network Analysis
subjects.syllabus: Covers network theorems, transient response, resonance, and analysis of electrical circuits.

subjects.name: Signals and Systems
subjects.syllabus: Focuses on continuous and discrete-time signals, LTI systems, transforms, and signal processing fundamentals.

subjects.name: Probability Theory and Stochastic Processes
subjects.syllabus: Develops the basics of probability, random variables, distributions, correlation, and stochastic processes.

subjects.name: Analog Circuits
subjects.syllabus: Deals with transistor amplifiers, feedback, oscillators, and analog electronics design.

subjects.name: Digital Logic Design
subjects.syllabus: Introduces Boolean algebra, logic gates, combinational logic, sequentials, and digital design principles.

subjects.name: Electromagnetic Waves and Transmission Lines
subjects.syllabus: Covers Maxwell equations, wave propagation, transmission lines, and field behavior in communication systems.

subjects.name: Microprocessors and Microcontrollers
subjects.syllabus: Covers architecture, instruction sets, interfacing, interrupts, timers, and embedded-system basics.

subjects.name: Electronic Devices Laboratory
subjects.syllabus: Experiments on diode and transistor characteristics, rectifiers, and amplifier behavior.

subjects.name: Digital Design Laboratory
subjects.syllabus: Practical work with logic circuits, counters, flip-flops, and basic digital system design.

subjects.name: Analog and Digital Communication
subjects.syllabus: Covers modulation, demodulation, noise, bandwidth, digital signaling, and communication theory.

subjects.name: Antenna Design and Wave Propagation
subjects.syllabus: Introduces antenna principles, radiation mechanisms, propagation models, and wireless system behavior.

subjects.name: IoT Architectures and Protocols
subjects.syllabus: Introduces IoT architecture, sensor networking, communication protocols, and embedded wireless systems.

subjects.name: CMOS VLSI Design
subjects.syllabus: Teaches CMOS inverter design, logic design, fabrication principles, and low-power VLSI considerations.

subjects.name: Digital Signal Processing
subjects.syllabus: Covers transforms, z-transform, FFT, FIR and IIR filters, and real-world signal processing.

subjects.name: Communication Lab
subjects.syllabus: Practical experiments in modulation, filters, signal measurement, and communication system testing.

subjects.name: IoT and Embedded Lab
subjects.syllabus: Applies embedded programming, sensing, interfacing, and IoT protocol testing in the laboratory.
